mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while RETAIL_REC remains depressed, households are substituting away from out-of-home leisure and shopping, so retail mobility should stay lower over the next two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises to at or above the last 28-day average despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 6 points.
